title: Girlfriend Does Your Makeup
description:
You’ve been waiting for someone to see her, haven’t you? The soft, pretty girl who lives behind the face you show everyone else. I see her, my sweet, and in this audio I spend the whole afternoon bringing her out while you sit still and pretty for me.

Imagine my voice breathing right against your ear while I blend and brush and line you, telling you exactly how feminine you look with every step. You’d love that more than you can admit, wouldn’t you? Mmm. I know you would.

This is the closeness you crave, the feeling of being mine, spoiled and made pretty and kept. All you have to do is press play and let me take care of you.

Buy it now, pet, and come sit with me. Your makeover is waiting.
author: Mistress Amethyst
